"""Least-privilege scope tests for SQL connections Core mutation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SEMANTIC = ROOT / "backend/modules/worker_ingress/semantic_capabilities.py"
POOL = ROOT / "backend/core/pool.py"

def _module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_sql_connections_core_scope_semantic_capabilities", SEMANTIC)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def _build(module, *, context: str, path: str, source_sha256: str):
    return module.resolve_capability("DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED").builder({"bounded_context": context, "constraints": {"change_spec": [{"operation": "append_once", "path": path, "source_sha256": source_sha256, "replacement": "\n# sql-connections-scope-test-marker\n"}], "verification_tests": []}})

def test_sql_connections_context_allows_exact_pool_path_without_writing():
    module = _module(); before = POOL.read_bytes(); source_sha = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
    result = _build(module, context="SQL_CONNECTIONS_8OF10", path="backend/core/pool.py", source_sha256=source_sha)
    assert result["actions"][0]["path"] == "backend/core/pool.py"
    assert result["actions"][0]["type"] == "append_once"
    assert POOL.read_bytes() == before

def test_other_context_cannot_mutate_pool_path():
    module = _module(); source_sha = hashlib.sha256(POOL.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SEMANTIC_DEV_PATH_FORBIDDEN"):
        _build(module, context="OTHER_CONTEXT", path="backend/core/pool.py", source_sha256=source_sha)

def test_sql_connections_context_cannot_mutate_other_core_path():
    module = _module()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SEMANTIC_DEV_PATH_FORBIDDEN"):
        _build(module, context="SQL_CONNECTIONS_8OF10", path="backend/core/security.py", source_sha256="0" * 64)
